en: A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a packed open-air amphitheater with curved stone seating surrounding a central circular stage. The backdrop is a long neoclassical colonnaded façade with doors and decorations, and many people wearing early-20th‑century style hats fill the stands. Printed caption text appears below the image, and red handwritten numbers are on the bottom left and right margins.
